findings.mechanism: N+1 query pattern: each order serialization issues a separate SELECT for its line items, causing query count to grow linearly with number of orders (Reference: correctness and cost at the database boundary)
findings.remediation: Fetch orders and their line items in a single query using a join or selectinload to eliminate the per‑order SELECT for line items
findings.arithmetic: Base order query = 1; per order line‑item query = 1. For 50 orders this yields 1 + 50 = 51 queries per request, exceeding acceptable limits

prediction.condition: GET /orders listing for a customer with 50 orders each having 3 line items
